def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            comp = []
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                comp.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        stack.append((ny,nx))
            objects.append((color, comp))

    frame = max(objects, key=lambda o: len(o[1]))
    fc = frame[0]
    top = min(y for y,x in frame[1])
    bottom = max(y for y,x in frame[1])
    left = min(x for y,x in frame[1])
    right = max(x for y,x in frame[1])
    H, W = bottom-top+1, right-left+1
    out = [row[left:right+1] for row in grid[top:bottom+1]]
    frame_set = set(frame[1])
    markers = {}
    local_seen = set(frame_set)
    for y in range(top, bottom+1):
        for x in range(left, right+1):
            if grid[y][x] != bg or (y,x) in local_seen:
                continue
            comp = []
            stack = [(y,x)]
            local_seen.add((y,x))
            while stack:
                a,b = stack.pop()
                comp.append((a,b))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx = a+dy,b+dx
                    if top <= ny <= bottom and left <= nx <= right and (ny,nx) not in local_seen and grid[ny][nx] == bg:
                        local_seen.add((ny,nx))
                        stack.append((ny,nx))
            my = min(a for a,b in comp)
            mx = min(b for a,b in comp)
            shape = tuple(sorted((a-my,b-mx) for a,b in comp))
            markers.setdefault(shape, []).append((my-top,mx-left))

    for color, comp in objects:
        if color in (bg, fc) or (color == 1 and bg == 1):
            continue
        if any(top <= y <= bottom and left <= x <= right for y,x in comp):
            continue
        my = min(y for y,x in comp)
        mx = min(x for y,x in comp)
        shape = tuple(sorted((y-my,x-mx) for y,x in comp))
        for y,x in markers.get(shape, []):
            for dy,dx in shape:
                out[y+dy][x+dx] = color
    return out
